messages:
Elinor: quick check — i opened a tiny TF change that moves svc projected token data under `secret/rs/service-tokens/<cluster>/<svc>` in staging. goal is to keep per-cluster keyspace separate and avoid rotate-all when we redeploy a controller. can someone skim?

James: link?

Elinor: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/+/r12345 (PR) — main change is vault_path in module:
```hcl
module "service_tokens" {
  source = "git::ssh://git.redwood/infra/modules/vault-tokenizer.git//?ref=v2"
  vault_path = "secret/rs/service-tokens/${var.cluster_name}/${var.service}"
}
```

Sachin: quick q — do we still have any consumers reading the old path `secret/rs/tokens/<svc>`?

Elinor: good call. i grep'd staging and only found the controller and a legacy cron job in payments. i added a compatibility ExternalSecret for one week to mirror reads while the cron migrates.

Marta: pinging payments infra owner @sanjay? can the cron switch to the new mount by monday?

James: two small concerns: (1) rotation hook in the tokenizer expects the `lease_id` in metadata.path, (2) terraform state for existing secrets — we need an import plan otherwise TF will try to delete/recreate.

Elinor: on (1) i updated the rotation lambda to accept both old & new path formats for 14 days. on (2) i'd prefer a short import script in the PR description. adding here:
```bash
# import existing secrets to new path key naming
for s in $(vault list -format=json secret/rs/tokens | jq -r ".[]"); do
  vault kv get -field=data secret/rs/tokens/$s > /tmp/$s.json
  vault kv put secret/rs/service-tokens/staging/$s @/tmp/$s.json
done
```

Sachin: that import script will double-write but ok for staging. for prod i'd rather a one-off migration runbook.

Marta: will coordinate with payments to migrate the cron. thanks for the compatibility ExternalSecret addition — can you paste the ES snippet?

Elinor: sure — ES for staging:
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: payments-legacy-token-mirror
  annotations:
    infra.redwood.io/migration-note: "mirror old -> new for 7d"
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1m
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-kv
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: payments-token
  data:
  - secretKey: token.json
    remoteRef:
      key: secret/rs/tokens/payments
      property: data
```

James: LGTM for staging if you add a TODO to remove after 7d and add an owner. also add an explicit lifecycle.ignore_changes for the TF secret resource to avoid accidental rotation on apply.

Elinor: done in PR comments.

Deploy Bot: apply stage/terraform/service_tokens r12345 — plan: 2 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy — started by elinor — https://ci.redwood/builds/789

James: nice :tada: — will monitor logs for any `permission denied` when the tokenizer reads new paths.

Sachin: i'll add a prometheus alert for vault-2xx-mismatch for the controller (low noise) so we catch choked reads early.

Marta: thanks team — i'll follow up on payments migration timeline and update the PR. if no issues, schedule prod migration Wed next week. :+1:

Elinor: thanks all — i'll post a short runbook in the PR and remove the ES mirror after confirmation.
